tests.title: Pad trigger and LED coverage
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check Push 3 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all pad controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed

tests.title: Firmware and software compatibility
steps: Inspect device model and installed firmware.
Check exact model's official support page for updates and compatible software.
Record version, OS, source and date.

tests.title: Input impedance/gain mode and ADAT expansion
tests.why: Validate this manufacturer-documented feature using a known-good signal or application.
steps: Connect known-good LINE signal to input 1 and 2 and capture.
Check supported instrument and high gain modes with suitable source and safe levels.
Attach compatible ADAT interface and verify expanded input mapping.
equipment: Known-good test signal or compatible software

tests.title: Pedal CV output configuration
tests.why: Validate this manufacturer-documented feature using a known-good signal or application.
steps: Enable CV functionality on the appropriate pedal port.
Use an appropriate meter or CV-compatible receiving device to observe controlled output.
Do not test CV input on analog audio jacks: it is unsupported.
equipment: Known-good test signal or compatible software
